# Third-party submodules

This directory contains third-party code vendored as git submodules.

- `agentize`: https://github.com/SyntheSys-Lab/agentize.git

Clone with submodules:

```bash
git clone --recurse-submodules <REPO_URL>
```

Or, if you already cloned the repo, initialize submodules with:

```bash
git submodule update --init --recursive
```
